# Action catalog

Every action can be called from server code (`callAction`), over REST
(`POST /api/v1/actions/<name>`) and over MCP (tool name = action name with `.` → `_`).
See [actions.md](./actions.md) for how the system works.

## Permissions by role

| Permission | Meaning | owner | admin | manager | staff |
| --- | --- | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| `admin.access` | Open the admin app (/admin). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `users.read` | View and search all contacts (people, customers, staff). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `users.manage` | Create, edit, archive and restore contacts, and add or remove their tags; create and delete tags. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `roles.manage` | Grant and revoke staff roles. | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `activity.read` | View the activity log and the change history of records. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `errors.manage` | View error reports with full technical detail (stack traces, inputs) and mark them fixed. | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `api_keys.manage` | Create and revoke API keys for yourself (REST API and MCP). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `settings.manage` | Change business settings and integrations in Admin → Settings. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `docs.internal` | Read internal (staff-only) docs at /docs and over the API/MCP. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `automations.manage` | Create, edit, turn on/off and test automations, see their runs and the event log. Automations act as the system, so only owners and admins have this. | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `notifications.manage` | See every notification sent to anyone and its delivery status; retry failed ones. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `inquiries.manage` | See and work through website inquiries (contact-form messages): change their status, add notes, archive them. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `data.export` | Download CSV exports of contacts and of the activity log (personal data: owners, admins and managers). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `system.manage` | See system health, scheduled jobs and background jobs; retry or cancel jobs. (Technical — owners and admins.) | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |

### contacts.list

**List contacts** — Search and list contacts (customers, leads, staff, vendors — everyone). Filter by tag slug (e.g. tag="customer") and/or a free-text search over name, email, phone and company. Archived contacts are hidden unless includeArchived is true.

- Who: `users.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { contacts: Contact[] (each with tags, roles, hasLogin), total: number }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tag": {
      "description": "Only contacts with this tag slug, e.g. \"customer\", \"lead\", \"staff\".",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "search": {
      "description": "Matches name, email, phone or company (partial, case-insensitive).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "includeArchived": {
      "default": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    },
    "offset": {
      "default": 0,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    }
  }
}
```

### contacts.get

**Get contact** — Fetch one contact by id, including tags, staff roles and whether they have a login.

- Who: `users.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: Contact (with tags, roles, hasLogin)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
      "description": "Contact id."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.create

**Create contact** — Create a contact — anyone the business deals with. Say what they are with tags: e.g. tags=["lead"] for a new lead, ["customer"], ["staff","customer"] for an employee who is also a customer, ["vendor"]. Tags only describe the person; they do NOT grant app access (use access.grantRole for that). Fails with "conflict" if the email already exists — use contacts.list to find that contact instead.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The new Contact (with tags, roles, hasLogin)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "firstName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "lastName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "companyName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "email": {
      "description": "Email address. Stored lower-case; must be unique across contacts.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "phone": {
      "description": "Phone number in any common format; stored as E.164 (+18165551234). US is assumed.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tags": {
      "default": [],
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "description": "Tag slugs, e.g. [\"customer\"] or [\"staff\",\"customer\"]. Use tags.list to see them."
    }
  }
}
```

### contacts.update

**Update contact** — Change a contact’s details. Only the fields you send are changed; send null to clear a field. To change tags use contacts.addTags / contacts.removeTags. Changing the email of someone who has a login or a staff role needs roles.manage (the email is how a login finds its contact, so it is security-sensitive). Every change is kept in the record history (activity.changes).

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The updated Contact

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "firstName": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "lastName": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "companyName": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "email": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "description": "Email address. Stored lower-case; must be unique across contacts.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "phone": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "description": "Phone number in any common format; stored as E.164 (+18165551234). US is assumed.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.archive

**Archive contact** — Disable a contact and hide them from lists without deleting their history: their login and API keys stop working everywhere. Reversible with contacts.restore. Contacts are never hard-deleted through actions. The last owner cannot be archived.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, status }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.addTags

**Add tags to contact** — Add one or more tags to a contact, e.g. tags=["customer"] when a lead buys for the first time. Adding a tag the contact already has is a no-op. Tags never grant app access.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The updated Contact

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "tags": {

      "type": "array",

        "type": "string",
```

```json
  },
  "required": [
    "id",
    "tags"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.bulkAddTags

**Add tags to many contacts** — Add tags to up to 500 contacts at once, all in ONE transaction (all or nothing) and ONE activity-log entry. Contacts that already have a tag keep it. Emits `contact.tagged` for each contact that really got a new tag. An unknown id or tag slug fails the whole call before anything changes.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { contacts: number, tagged: number }  (contacts looked at, contacts that got something new)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 500,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
      },
      "description": "Contact ids (at most 500)."
    },
    "tags": {
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "description": "Tag slugs, e.g. [\"customer\"] or [\"staff\",\"customer\"]. Use tags.list to see them."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ids",
    "tags"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.bulkArchive

**Archive many contacts** — Archive up to 500 contacts at once in ONE transaction and ONE activity-log entry (their logins and API keys stop working; reversible with contacts.restore). Already archived ones are skipped. Refused (nothing archived) when it would archive the last active owner. Emits `contact.archived` for each.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { archived: number, alreadyArchived: number }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 500,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
      },
      "description": "Contact ids (at most 500)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ids"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.import

**Import contacts from CSV** — Create contacts from CSV text (a header row, then at most 2000 rows). Recognised columns: first_name, last_name, company, email, phone, notes, tags (semicolon-separated slugs). Every row is validated; a row whose email already exists (in the system or earlier in the file) is a duplicate and skipped — existing contacts are never changed. Each created contact gets `tags` (the input, plus its own tags column), source "import" and a `contact.created` event. ALWAYS run it first with dryRun=true: nothing is saved, and `problems` lists every row that would be skipped and why. Without dryRun, valid rows are created (one transaction) and bad rows are skipped, not fatal.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { dryRun, total, created, duplicates, invalid, problems: [{ row, status: "duplicate" | "invalid", message }], problemsTruncated }  (row = the row’s number in the file, the header being row 1; blank lines are not counted)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "csv": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 2000000,
      "description": "The file’s text, header row first."
    },
    "dryRun": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "Check only: save nothing.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "tags": {
      "default": [],
      "description": "Tags added to every created contact.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "csv"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.exportCsv

**Export contacts as CSV** — Personal data, so it needs `data.export` and is written to the activity log. Returns the contacts (filter by tag slug and/or search; archived are left out unless asked) as CSV text — columns id, first_name, last_name, company, email, phone, tags (semicolon-separated), status, source, sms_consent, notes, created_at — in `csv`, with the suggested `filename`. At most 10,000 rows (`truncated` says when more matched). The same columns are what contacts.import reads back.

- Who: `data.export`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { filename, contentType: "text/csv", csv, rows, truncated }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tag": {
      "description": "Only contacts with this tag slug.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "search": {
      "description": "Matches name, email, phone or company.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "includeArchived": {
      "default": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

- Changes data: no
- Returns: Tag[] with contactCount

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### tags.create

**Create tag** — Create a new tag. Use kind="type" only for a new top-level contact category (it appears in the admin Contacts menu); otherwise kind="label".

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The new Tag

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "slug": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$",
      "description": "Machine name, e.g. \"net-30\". Permanent."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60
    },
    "kind": {
      "default": "label",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "type",
        "label"
      ]
    },
    "color": {
      "default": "neutral",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "neutral",
        "brand",
        "blue",
        "green",
        "amber",
        "red",
        "purple",
        "teal"
      ]
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 300
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "slug",
    "label"
  ]
}
```

```json
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
```

### access.grantRole

**Grant role** — Give a contact a staff role, which unlocks /admin. The person signs in with their normal login (the contact must have one, or will get the role when they first sign in with that email). Only owners can grant "owner"; owners and admins can grant the rest.

- Who: `roles.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The updated Contact

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "contactId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "owner",
        "admin",
        "manager",
        "staff"
      ],
      "description": "owner: Everything, including managing other staff and owners. | admin: Everything except granting the owner role. | manager: Runs day-to-day operations in admin: people, activity, notifications, settings. | staff: Admin access for day-to-day work; read-only on people and settings."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "contactId",
    "role"
  ]
}
```

### activity.list

**List activity** — The audit trail, newest first: every change (successful or not), every sign-in/sign-out and password event, every denied attempt, and every API/MCP call including reads — who (person, API key/AI, system), which channel (web, api, mcp, system), from which IP, what, and whether it worked. Filter by subject to see one record’s history, by actor or API key to see what someone (or an AI) did. Page with `before` = the occurredAt of the last row. Use activity.get for one entry’s field-level changes.

- Who: `activity.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: ActivityEntry[] with actorName and apiKeyName

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subjectId": {
      "description": "Only entries about this record, e.g. a contact id.",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "actorContactId": {
      "description": "Only entries by this person (including their API keys).",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "apiKeyId": {
      "description": "Only entries made with this API key.",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "requestId": {
      "description": "Only entries from one web/API request.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "action": {
      "description": "Only this action name, e.g. \"contacts.update\" or \"auth.signIn\".",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "kind": {
      "description": "change, read (API/MCP reads) or auth.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "change",
        "read",
        "auth"
      ]
    },
    "channel": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "web",
        "api",
        "mcp",
        "system",
        "cli",
        "automation"
      ]
    },
    "failedOnly": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "Only failures (denied, invalid input, errors).",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "q": {
      "description": "Search the summary and action name.",
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 2
    },
    "before": {
      "description": "Only entries older than this (for paging).",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### activity.get

**Get activity entry** — One audit entry in full: who, how, from where (IP, browser), the input, and every database row it changed with before → after values. Also lists the other entries from the same request.

- Who: `activity.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { entry, changes: ChangeEntry[], sameRequest: ActivityEntry[] }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### activity.changes

**Record history** — Field-level history of a record (a contact, product …): every insert, update and delete with before → after values, newest first, and who made it. Captured by the database itself, so it includes changes made outside the app (e.g. directly in the database) — those have no activityId and show the database user.

- Who: `activity.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, occurredAt, tableName, rowId, op, before, after, dbUser, activityId, action, actorKind, actorName, apiKeyName, channel }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subjectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
      "description": "The record, e.g. a contact id or product id."
    },
    "before": {
      "description": "Only changes older than this (for paging).",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "subjectId"
  ]
}
```

### activity.exportCsv

**Export the activity log as CSV** — The audit trail as CSV text for a period (`from` / `to`) and optional filters — columns occurred_at, kind, action, actor_kind, actor, channel, subject_type, subject_id, summary, ok, error_code, error_ref, ip, request_id. Inputs are not included. Needs `data.export`; the export itself is logged. At most 20,000 rows, newest first (`truncated` says when more matched).

- Who: `data.export`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { filename, contentType: "text/csv", csv, rows, truncated }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "from": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "to": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "change",
        "read",
        "auth"
      ]
    },
    "action": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "failedOnly": {
      "default": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

### errors.list

**List errors** — Unexpected failures (bugs and outages), grouped: occurrences of the same bug share a fingerprint and are listed once with a count. Each group shows its newest reference — pass that to errors.get for the full report (stack, input, diagnosis). Open = at least one occurrence not marked fixed.

- Who: `errors.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ fingerprint, ref, code, message, source, action, path, count, openCount, firstSeen, lastSeen, resolution }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "default": "open",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "open",
        "resolved",
        "all"
      ]
    },
    "sinceDays": {
      "default": 30,
      "description": "Only errors seen in this window.",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 365
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### errors.get

**Get error report** — Everything known about one error, for fixing it: the diagnosis (code + hint), message, stack trace, cause chain, the action and its input (secrets redacted), who hit it and where, the deployed commit, how often the same bug has happened, and what else happened in the same request. `brief` is all of that as one Markdown document — start there. After fixing, call errors.resolve.

- Who: `errors.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { error, actorName, apiKeyName, occurrences, recentRefs, relatedActivity, brief }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 4,
      "description": "The error reference people see, e.g. \"E-7K3QX9MD\" (or a Next.js error digest)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ref"
  ]
}
```

### errors.resolve

**Mark error fixed** — Mark a bug fixed: every open occurrence with the same fingerprint as this reference is closed with your note. Say what fixed it (commit, PR link). If the bug happens again it shows up as open again.

- Who: `errors.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { resolved: number }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 4,
      "description": "The error reference people see, e.g. \"E-7K3QX9MD\" (or a Next.js error digest)."
    },
    "resolution": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 2000,
      "description": "What fixed it, e.g. \"Fixed in a1b2c3d — null check in contacts.update (PR #42)\"."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ref",
    "resolution"
  ]
}
```

### apiKeys.create

- Returns: { key (secret, shown once), apiKey }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",

      "description": "Limit the key to these permissions. Omit for all of your permissions.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "admin.access",
          "users.read",
          "users.manage",
          "roles.manage",
          "activity.read",
          "errors.manage",
          "api_keys.manage",
          "settings.manage",
          "docs.internal",
          "automations.manage",
          "notifications.manage",
          "inquiries.manage",
          "data.export",
          "system.manage"
        ]
      }
    },
    "expiresInDays": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 365
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ]
}
```

```json
    }
  },
```

**Change a setting** — Create or replace one setting. The value can be any JSON. Never store secrets here — they belong in environment variables.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { key, value }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "key": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$",
      "description": "Setting key, dotted, e.g. \"business.name\"."
    },
    "value": {
      "description": "Any JSON value.",
      "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "key",
    "value"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "__schema0": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "propertyNames": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "additionalProperties": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### integrations.list

**List integrations** — Outside services with whether they are configured (from environment variables — names only, never values), and whether staff have switched them on or off (kill switch) plus their non-secret config.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, label, description, core, configured, missing[], invalid[], enabled, config }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### integrations.update

**Switch an integration on/off or change its config** — Kill switch and non-secret config for one integration (an id from integrations.list). Whether it is configured still comes from environment variables.

- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, enabled, config }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Integration id, e.g. \"email\" or \"sms\"."
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },

      },
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### flags.list

**List feature flags** — Every feature flag the code knows, with its description, whether it was ever configured, and its current setting: `enabled` (the master switch), `percent` (gradual rollout, 0–100), `roles` and `contactIds` (always on for these). With none of percent/roles/contactIds an enabled flag is on for everyone.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ name, description, default, configured, enabled, percent?, roles?, contactIds? }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### flags.set

**Change a feature flag** — Turn a flag on/off (`enabled`) and/or change who gets it: `percent` (0–100, a stable share of people), `roles`, `contactIds`. Fields you leave out keep their value; pass null to clear percent / roles / contactIds. Only flags the code declares (flags.list) can be set. Takes up to ~10 seconds to reach every server.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The flag with its new setting

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "beta-dashboard",
        "new-checkout",
        "holiday-banner"
      ]
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "percent": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 100
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "roles": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "owner",
              "admin",
              "manager",
              "staff"
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "contactIds": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxItems": 500,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "uuid",
            "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ]
}
```

### search.query

**Search everything** — One search box for the ⌘K palette: contacts (name, email, phone, company), tags, docs, automations, inquiries, error reports by reference (type `E-…`) and activity-log summaries — only the kinds the caller may see (a customer gets docs only). Each hit is `{ type, id, title, subtitle, href }`; `href` is the page to open. Results are grouped by kind in a fixed order and cut at `limit`.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { results: [{ type, id, title, subtitle, href }] }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 100
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 20,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 50
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "q"
  ]
}
```

### automations.reference

**Automation building blocks** — Everything needed to write an automation: every event (when it fires, its data fields as JSON Schema, an example), every step type, condition operators, trigger shapes, the template syntax, the actions YOU may use in an action step (with their input as JSON Schema) and the staff permissions a notifyStaff step can target. Call this before automations.create.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { events, stepTypes, operators, templates, actions: [{ name, title, description, mutates, destructive, input }], permissions, schemas: { trigger, step, condition } }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

```json
{

}
```

### automations.create

**Create an automation** — Create an automation: a trigger (an event like contact.created, or a schedule), optional conditions, steps (run an action, wait, wait for an event, check a condition, message staff or a customer, call a webhook) and optional cancelOn rules. It starts OFF unless enabled=true; use automations.run to test it first. Call automations.reference for the event list, step shapes and template syntax. Every action used must be one you may run yourself.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The automation

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "definition": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 120
        },
        "description": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string",
              "maxLength": 2000
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "tags": {
          "description": "Labels for finding and grouping automations, e.g. [\"rentals\", \"follow-up\"]",
          "default": [],
          "maxItems": 20,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 40,
            "pattern": "^[^,]+$"
          }
        },
        "trigger": {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "event"
                },
                "event": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "Event name, e.g. contact.created (see automations.reference)"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "event"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "schedule"
                },
                "everyMinutes": {
                  "description": "Run every N minutes (at least 5)",
                  "type": "integer",
                  "minimum": 5,
                  "maximum": 10080
                },
                "dailyAt": {
                  "description": "Run once a day at this time in the app’s time zone (APP_TIME_ZONE), e.g. 08:30",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^([01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d$"
                },
                "weekdays": {
                  "description": "With dailyAt: only these days (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday)",
                  "minItems": 1,
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "maximum": 7
                  }
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type"
              ]
            }
          ]
        },
        "conditions": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "All must hold for a run to start (checked against the trigger event)",
          "maxItems": 20,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "path": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z_][\\w]*(\\.[\\w-]+)*$",
                "description": "Dotted path into the context, e.g. event.data.contactId or steps.contact.status"
              },
              "op": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "equals",
                  "notEquals",
                  "in",
                  "notIn",
                  "exists",
                  "notExists",
                  "gt",
                  "gte",
                  "lt",
                  "lte",
                  "contains"
                ]
              },
              "value": {
                "description": "Compared with (templates allowed). Not for exists."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "path",
              "op"
            ]
          }
        },
        "steps": {
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 100,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
          }
        },
        "cancelOn": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Events that stop a run that is still going",
          "maxItems": 10,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "event": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "e.g. role.revoked"
              },
              "match": {
                "description": "e.g. { field: \"data.orderId\", equals: \"{{event.data.contactId}}\" }",
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "field": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z_][\\w]*(\\.[\\w-]+)*$",
                    "description": "Dotted path into the context, e.g. event.data.contactId or steps.contact.status"
                  },
                  "equals": {}
                },
                "required": [
                  "field",
                  "equals"
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "event"
            ]
          }
        },
        "concurrencyKey": {
          "description": "Template, e.g. {{event.data.contactId}}: while a run with the same value is active, new ones are skipped",
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string",
              "maxLength": 200
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "name",
        "trigger",
        "steps"
      ]
    },
    "enabled": {
      "default": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "definition"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "__schema0": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "action"
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "An action name, e.g. contacts.addTags (see GET /api/v1/actions)"
                },
                "input": {
                  "default": {},
                  "description": "Its input (templates allowed)",
                  "type": "object",
                  "propertyNames": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "additionalProperties": {}
                },
                "continueOnError": {
                  "default": false,
                  "description": "Keep going if the action refuses (not_found, conflict …). Default: stop the run.",
                  "type": "boolean"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "action"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "wait"
                },
                "for": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^\\d{1,4}(m|h|d|w)$",
                  "description": "How long to pause, e.g. 3d"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "for"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "waitForEvent"
                },
                "event": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The event to wait for, e.g. role.revoked"
                },
                "match": {
                  "description": "Only an event whose field (e.g. data.itemId) equals this value (templates allowed)",
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "field": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z_][\\w]*(\\.[\\w-]+)*$",
                      "description": "Dotted path into the context, e.g. event.data.contactId or steps.contact.status"
                    },
                    "equals": {}
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "field",
                    "equals"
                  ]
                },
                "timeout": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^\\d{1,4}(m|h|d|w)$",
                  "description": "Give up waiting after this long"
                },
                "onTimeout": {
                  "default": "continue",
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "continue",
                    "stop"
                  ]
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "event",
                "timeout"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "condition"
```

### automations.update

**Edit an automation** — Replace an automation’s definition and/or turn it on or off. Runs already going keep the steps they started with; new runs use the new version. Send the whole definition (get it with automations.get, change it, send it back).

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The automation

```json
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "sendEmail"
                },
                "contactId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The contact, e.g. {{event.data.contactId}}"
                },
                "subject": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1,
                  "maxLength": 150
                },
                "body": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1,
                  "maxLength": 5000,
                  "description": "Starts after “Hi <first name>,”"
                },
                "url": {
                  "description": "Button link, e.g. /account",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 500
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "contactId",
                "subject",
                "body"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "sendText"
                },
                "contactId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The contact, e.g. {{event.data.contactId}}"
                },
                "text": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1,
                  "maxLength": 320,
                  "description": "The text message (keep it under 160 characters for one SMS)"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "contactId",
                "text"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
                },
                "label": {
                  "description": "What it does, for people",
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 120
                },
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "webhook"
                },
                "url": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "format": "uri",
                  "description": "HTTPS address that receives a signed POST (Zapier, n8n, your own service)"
                },
                "body": {
                  "description": "JSON to send (templates allowed). Default: the event."
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type",
                "url"
              ]
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "id": {
              "description": "Name for this step so later steps can use its output: {{steps.<id>.…}}",
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,39}$"
            },
            "label": {
              "description": "What it does, for people",
              "type": "string",
              "maxLength": 120
            },
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "branch"
            },
            "match": {
              "default": "all",
              "description": "all = every condition must hold (AND); any = at least one (OR)",
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "all",
                "any"
              ]
            },
            "conditions": {
              "minItems": 1,
              "maxItems": 20,
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "path": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z_][\\w]*(\\.[\\w-]+)*$",
                    "description": "Dotted path into the context, e.g. event.data.contactId or steps.contact.status"
                  },
                  "op": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "equals",
                      "notEquals",
                      "in",
                      "notIn",
                      "exists",
                      "notExists",
                      "gt",
                      "gte",
                      "lt",
                      "lte",
                      "contains"
                    ]
                  },
                  "value": {
                    "description": "Compared with (templates allowed). Not for exists."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "path",
                  "op"
                ]
              }
            },
            "then": {
              "default": [],
              "description": "Steps when the conditions hold",
              "maxItems": 50,
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
              }
            },
            "else": {
              "default": [],
              "description": "Steps when they don’t",
              "maxItems": 50,
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "type",
            "conditions"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### automations.archive

**Archive an automation** — Turn an automation off for good and hide it from the list. Runs still going are cancelled. Its history is kept.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, cancelledRuns }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### automations.duplicate

**Duplicate an automation** — Copy an automation (trigger, conditions, steps, tags) as a new one named “Copy of …”. The copy starts OFF and has no runs.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The new automation

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "Default: “Copy of <name>”",
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### automations.run

**Run an automation now** — Start a run right now (even if the automation is off) — to test it, or to do it by hand. For an event trigger, `data` is the pretend event’s data (default: the event’s example, whose ids don’t exist). Conditions still apply. Steps REALLY run (messages are sent, records change), so test with real records you own.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { status: started | skipped | conditions, runId?, reason? }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "data": {
      "description": "Event data for the run",
      "type": "object",
      "propertyNames": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### automations.listRuns

**List automation runs** — Automation runs, newest first, across all automations or one: status (running, waiting, completed, failed, cancelled, skipped), the step it is on, what it is waiting for, and errors.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, automationId, automationName, status, currentStep, wakeAt, waitingEvent, note, error, createdAt, finishedAt }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "automationId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "running",
          "waiting",
          "completed",
          "failed",
          "cancelled",
          "skipped"
        ]
      }
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### automations.getRun

**Get an automation run** — One run in full: what triggered it, each step (its definition, status, output or error) and where it is now.

- Who: `automations.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { run, automation: { id, name }, steps: [{ index, step, status, output, error, startedAt, finishedAt }] } — steps are flattened: a branch step has elseAt/endAt (its yes steps are index+1 … elseAt-1, its no steps elseAt … endAt-1); status “skipped” = on the branch arm that wasn’t taken.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

**Cancel an automation run** — Stop a run that is still going or waiting. Steps already done are not undone.

```json
{

    }
  },
  "required": [

}
```

### notifications.list

**My notifications** — The signed-in person’s notification inbox, newest first, with the unread count and how many urgent ones are unread. `view`: all, unread, or attention (urgent types, e.g. error spikes). Dismissed ones are left out. Page with `before`.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { items: [{ id, type, urgent, title, body, url, action, createdAt, readAt }], unread, attention }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "view": {
      "default": "all",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "unread",
        "attention"
      ]
    },
    "before": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 30,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 100
    }
  }
}
```

### notifications.recent

**Recent notifications (the bell)** — The latest few items of the signed-in person’s inbox for the notification bell, newest first, each with the `href` to open, plus the unread count. Lighter than notifications.list (no paging, no views). Dismissed items are left out.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "default": 8,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 20
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
```

### notifications.markRead

**Mark notifications read** — Mark some (ids) or all of the signed-in person’s notifications as read. read=false marks the given ids unread again (ids required).

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
```

### notifications.setPreference

**Change a notification setting** — Turn one channel (email, sms, push) on or off for one notification type, for the signed-in person. Email for required types (receipts, security) can’t be turned off. Turning SMS on does nothing until the person has agreed to texts (notifications.setSmsConsent).

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { type, channel, enabled }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {

    },
    "channel": {

        "sms",
        "push"
      ]

      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },

    "channel",
    "enabled"
  ]
}
```

### notifications.setSmsConsent

**Text message consent** — Record that a person agreed (consent=true) or no longer agrees (consent=false) to automated texts. Without it nobody is ever texted. For yourself: optionally also set your mobile number. For someone else (they agreed in person or on the phone): needs users.manage and is recorded as given to staff. The exact wording agreed to is stored with the consent.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { consentAt, phone }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "contactId": {
      "description": "Someone else (staff only). Omit for yourself.",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "consent": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "phone": {
      "description": "Set this mobile number at the same time.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "consent"
  ]
}
```

### notifications.deliveries

**Notification delivery log** — Every email, text and push sent (or not) to anyone, newest first: to whom, which type, the status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, skipped) and why it failed or was skipped. Filter by contact to see what one person was sent.

- Who: `notifications.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, channel, status, to, attempts, lastError, sentAt, deliveredAt, nextAttemptAt, type, title, contactId, contactName, createdAt }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "contactId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "pending",
        "sending",
        "sent",
        "delivered",
        "failed",
        "skipped"
      ]
    },
    "channel": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "email",
        "sms",
        "push"
      ]
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "before": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 100,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### notifications.retry

### push.subscribe

**Turn on push on this device** — Save this browser’s Web Push subscription (the object `pushManager.subscribe()` returns: `endpoint` and `keys.p256dh` / `keys.auth`) so notifications can reach it. Needs the VAPID public key from push.status. Subscribing the same endpoint again just refreshes it; an endpoint that belonged to someone else on a shared device moves to the person now signed in.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Rate limit: 30 per 3600s per caller
- Returns: { id, endpoint, label }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",

          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 10,
          "maxLength": 200
        },
        "auth": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 8,
          "maxLength": 100
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "p256dh",
        "auth"
      ]
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "e.g. \"Chrome on Android\".",
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 100
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "endpoint",
    "keys"
  ]
}
```

### webhooks.resendEvent

**Handle a Resend webhook** — System only: apply one verified Resend event. `email.delivered` marks the delivery delivered; `email.bounced` (a permanent bounce suppresses the address) and `email.complained` (always suppresses) mark it failed / flagged and emit `email.bounced`; `email.failed` marks the delivery failed. Other types are acknowledged and ignored. Safe to repeat.

- Who: `system`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { handled: boolean, type }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "eventId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "The provider’s event/delivery id (the dedupe key)."
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 100
    },
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "propertyNames": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "eventId",
    "type",
    "data"
  ]
}
```

### webhooks.quoEvent

**Handle a Quo webhook** — System only: apply one verified Quo event. `message.received` records the inbound text as an `sms.received` event; if the whole message is STOP (also STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END, QUIT) the number is suppressed and the recorded SMS consent cleared, if it is START (or UNSTOP) the suppression is lifted and consent recorded again (source "sms-reply"). `message.delivered` updates the delivery’s status. Other types are acknowledged and ignored. Safe to repeat.

- Who: `system`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { handled: boolean, type, keyword? }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "eventId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "The provider’s event/delivery id (the dedupe key)."
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 100
    },
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "propertyNames": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "eventId",
    "type",
    "data"
  ]
}
```

### files.requestUpload

**Start a file upload** — Step 1 of uploading a photo or document to a record: checks the type and size, and returns `uploadUrl`. PUT the raw bytes there with the same Content-Type header (within 2 hours), then call files.confirm. Needs permission to add files of that purpose to that record.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Rate limit: 120 per 3600s per caller
- Returns: { fileId, uploadUrl, method: "PUT", headers }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "purpose": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "avatar",
        "contact_document",
        "data_export"
      ],
      "description": "What the file is: avatar (a contact’s public profile photo; only yourself or staff with users.manage) or contact_document (private paperwork on a contact; users.manage to add, users.read to see) or data_export (a person’s own data export, made by account.exportData; cannot be uploaded)."
    },
    "subjectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
      "description": "The record the file belongs to (a contact id for avatar / contact_document)."
    },
    "filename": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "contentType": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "sizeBytes": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "caption": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 500
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "purpose",
    "subjectId",
    "filename",
    "contentType",
    "sizeBytes"
  ]
}
```

### inquiries.create

**Send an inquiry** — Public: the website’s contact form. Stores the message, links it to the contact with that email (creating a `lead` contact when there is none — an existing customer is linked, not re-tagged), emits `inquiry.created` and tells staff with inquiries.manage. Always answers `{ received: true }`. `website` is a honeypot for bots: real forms leave it empty (hide it with CSS); anything in it is silently dropped. Rate-limited and bot-checked.

- Who: `public`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Rate limit: 5 per 3600s per caller
- Guests must pass the human check (Turnstile) when it is configured
- Returns: { received: true }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120
    },
    "email": {
      "description": "Email address. Stored lower-case; must be unique across contacts.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "phone": {
      "description": "Phone number in any common format; stored as E.164 (+18165551234). US is assumed.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 5,
      "maxLength": 5000
    },
    "source": {
      "default": "website",
      "description": "Which form, e.g. \"pricing\".",
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 50
    },
    "website": {
      "description": "Honeypot — leave empty.",
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 500
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name",
    "email",
    "message"
  ]
}
```

### newsletter.subscribe

**Subscribe to the newsletter** — Public: ask to join the newsletter. Finds or creates the contact (a new one is tagged `lead`). The answer is the same whether or not the address was already known, so it cannot be used to find out who is on the list. `website` is a honeypot: leave it empty.

- Who: `public`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)

```json
      "maxLength": 100
    },
```

```json
    },
    "bucket": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "filename": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "sizeBytes": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "contactId",
    "fileId",
    "bucket",
    "path",
    "filename",
    "sizeBytes"
  ]
}
```

### account.requestDeletion

**Delete my account** — Ask to delete the signed-in person’s account. Nothing is erased yet: after a grace period (setting `account.deletionGraceDays`, default 14 days) the daily job wipes their personal data (name, email, phone, tags, roles, inbox, devices, files, API keys) and unlinks their login; the contact row stays, anonymised, so history still points somewhere. They can cancel any time before (account.cancelDeletion). Refused for the last owner. Only the person themself, signed in on the website — not an API key or AI. Asking again while a request is pending returns that request.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Rate limit: 5 per 3600s per caller
- Returns: { id, requestedAt, scheduledFor, graceDays, alreadyRequested }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "reason": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 1000
    }
  }
}
```

### account.cancelDeletion

**Keep my account** — Cancel a pending account deletion before the grace period ends. Nothing was erased yet.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### account.deletionStatus

**Is my account being deleted?** — The signed-in person’s pending deletion request (when it was asked and when it will happen), or null, and the grace period in days.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { pending: { id, requestedAt, scheduledFor } | null, graceDays }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### account.processDeletions

**Carry out due account deletions** — System only (the daily maintenance step): anonymise every contact whose pending deletion is past its scheduled time, emit `account.deleted` for each, and keep (with a note) any request that would remove the last active owner. Safe to run repeatedly.

- Who: `system`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { processed: number, skipped: number }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "default": 25,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 100
    }
  }
}
```

### docs.list

**List docs** — The in-app docs: short how-tos (public) and, for staff, runbooks and rules (internal: how to use Admin → Errors, brand rules …). Returns only the docs the caller may read. Search with `query`; read one with docs.get. Check here before guessing how something works or how the brand should look.

- Who: `public`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { sections: [{ id, title }], docs: [{ slug, section, title, summary, audience }] }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "description": "Words to search for (all must match).",
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "section": {
      "description": "Only docs in this section id.",
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 50
    }
  }
}
```

### docs.get

**Read a doc** — One doc as Markdown, by slug (from docs.list, e.g. `start/getting-started`). Internal docs are only returned to staff; for anyone else they are "not found".

- Who: `public`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { slug, section, title, summary, audience, url, markdown }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "slug": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 120,
      "description": "The doc slug, e.g. `start/getting-started` (also accepts `/docs/start/getting-started`)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "slug"
  ]
}
```
